text:
ana.partnerships: Kickoff note 1: launching a small Shadow Mentor pilot for SIs focused on Marketplace + Private deploy flows. Target cohort: 4 SIs, week of May 2. Need owners for mentor roster, demo checklist, cert gating, and kit delivery. Who volunteers?

eli.enablement: I can draft the mentor playbook and badge criteria. Thinking: Attendance badge, Lab-pass badge, Proctored-demo badge. Will post a draft by Thu.

sam.si-lead: From SI side we want the lab to cover: 1) push model to Dedicated, 2) create marketplace metadata, 3) trigger fallback to Hosted. Also need a template for metadata.

jules.ops: Sandbox note: hosted sandboxes take 48h to provision; for quick turnarounds use offline kit. Also Dedicated maintenance Sat 02:00 UTC could interfere. If anyone needs capacity, file partner-sandbox form and cc me.

maya.training: I have an offline facilitator bundle (slides, labs, proctor checklist). Proctoring: record demo + 15-min live Q&A. Recommend 75% checklist pass.

ana.partnerships: small correction: I'm ana, not nana :blush: 

ana.partnerships: Ownership recap: Eli -> playbook and badges; Maya -> facilitator kit + proctor SOP; Sam -> SI exercise spec + mentor contacts; Jules -> sandbox ops. I'll assemble invites once contacts are in.

sam.si-lead: I'll confirm 4 mentors by Tue and share emails. Can someone share a Marketplace metadata snippet?

maya.training: snippet coming: ```yaml
marketplace:
  title: "Redwood SI demo"
  summary: "private deploy + fallback demo"
  contact: "si-support@example.com"
```

eli.enablement: I'll publish the playbook draft to the partner repo by Thu EOD and link it.

jules.ops: Filed CAP-10111 for sandbox capacity. Infra note: infra-bot says no infra changes are planned during the pilot window.

infra-bot: Deployment window check OK. No conflicting maintenance windows.

ana.partnerships: Perfect. Plan: dry-run Fri internal, pilot week of May 2. Thanks team!
